answer: When an operator drags an element, the path curves in a way that reflects hand and device: the curvature distribution and the speed along the path are stable per person. A scripted drag is a straight line at constant speed, so the network scores drag paths against the account's own curvature history. A lagoon out of place triggers the check: the session is frozen until its pattern clears. The spiral marks the start and the delta the end, yet the session is checked again at both points.
